title: Identify root cause of deploy failure from logs
ideal_answer:
The new image came up and tried to connect to Redis, but a NetworkPolicy change 14 minutes earlier (commit `8e2a1f3` by @marek) had removed the egress rule allowing port 6379 to the `cache` namespace. Pods got `ECONNREFUSED` on every attempt, went into CrashLoopBackOff, and auto-rollback to v4.18.1 fired.

The `v4.18.1` pods that are back up are still in the same fragile state — their Redis connections predate the policy change, so they're working on borrowed time. Anything that forces a fresh connection (pod restart, Redis blip, redeploy) will hit the same error until the rule is restored.
